# Stella Maynard

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c7 P4](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0004), [v3 c9 P9](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** Student and former schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c7 P4](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0004), [v3 c9 P9](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0009), [v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

Stella is a vivid, black-eyed girl with an attractive, red-rosy appearance. In her second year at Redmond College, she was recognized as carrying off the palm for beauty in her class.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P4](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0004), [v2 c11 P6](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0006)_

## Personality

Stella possesses a heartful of wistful dreams and fancies, though she can also be candid and severely practical. She is sensitive to her surroundings, once remarking how a pouring rainy night could squelch anyone's spirits. While capable of sharp humor and cynicism regarding men, she is warmly loyal to her friends and deeply appreciative of beauty and inspiration.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P4](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0004), [v3 c9 P18](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0018), [v3 c10 P14](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0014), [v3 c16 P14](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0014), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 c35 P35](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0035)_

## Traits

- Wistful and imaginative  <sub>[v2 c7 P4](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0004)</sub>
- Outspoken and direct  <sub>[v3 c9 P9](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0009), [v3 c16 P14](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0014)</sub>
- Dislikes boarding houses  <sub>[v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching and managing a school  <sub>[v3 c9 P9](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0009)</sub>
- Writing essays and papers  <sub>[v2 c14 P33](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0033), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029)</sub>

## Goals

- To earn a Redmond degree and live comfortably with her chums in a rented house  <sub>[v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>

## History

Stella Maynard attended Queen's Academy with Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant before taking up a country schoolteaching post for two years. Growing weary of the trials and misunderstandings of country teaching, she decided to resume her studies at Redmond College, entering directly as a Sophomore. Tired of boardinghouse life, Stella proposed that she, Anne, Priscilla, and Philippa Gordon rent a house together—Patty's Place—with her Aunt Jamesina acting as housekeeper. During her time at Redmond, she actively participated in college life, wrote papers for the Philomathic Society, and successfully completed her Arts degree.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P4](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0004), [v2 c14 P33](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0033), [v3 c9 P9](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0009), [v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c10 P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029)_
